title: Zen Planner vs Mindbody for Studios (2026 Prices)
description: Zen Planner vs Mindbody: starting prices, plans, marketplace fees, payments, belt tracking and contracts, all from the vendors' pricing pages.
body:
Mindbody is built around booking and its consumer marketplace for fitness, wellness and beauty businesses. Zen Planner, founded by a martial arts school owner, is built around memberships, attendance and belt or skill tracking.

{{table:zen-planner,mindbody}}

Pricing

Zen Planner: Studio from $99/mo (scaled by active members), Essentials $198/mo, Ultimate $348/mo. Mindbody: from $79/mo per location (Starter), with Accelerate and Ultimate priced through sales. Mindbody charges per location, not per user; Zen Planner charges by active members, not staff.

Marketplace and payment fees

Mindbody lists your business on the Mindbody app for free, but charges 20% (capped at $30) on the first purchase by a new client the app sends you. Mindbody Payments charges a processing rate plus $0.10-$0.30 per transaction (North America and Asia), and you can use a third-party processor instead. Zen Planner works with Daxko Payments and preferred processors; rates aren't published.

Features that differ

  • Belt and skill tracking: listed by Zen Planner; not found on Mindbody's pricing page.
  • Staff payroll: listed by Zen Planner.
  • Pick-a-Spot and room/resource booking: Mindbody Accelerate and up.
  • Website: included at Mindbody's entry price; Zen Planner from $99/mo extra or in Essentials.
  • Branded app: Zen Planner $39/mo; Mindbody add-on (price not published).

Contracts

Zen Planner is month to month by default. Mindbody says terms depend on your plan and any promotion. {{aff:zenplanner|Visit Zen Planner}} {{aff:mindbody|Visit Mindbody}}

faq: Is Mindbody cheaper than Zen Planner?

Mindbody's published starting price ($79/mo per location) is lower than Zen Planner Studio's ($99/mo), but Mindbody publishes only the entry price, and new-client bookings from its app carry a 20% fee capped at $30.
Which is better for martial arts?
Zen Planner lists belt and skill tracking and was started by a martial arts school owner. We didn't find belt tracking on Mindbody's pricing page.
Do I have to use Mindbody Payments?
No. Mindbody says you can use a third-party payment processor.
Does Zen Planner charge for staff?
No. Zen Planner says prospects and staff are never charged; pricing scales with active members.
